title: XDS AD350 2026 current 24-speed specification
notes: Current exact 2026 regional listing specifies an X6 second-generation SLR aerodynamic aluminum frame, carbon fork, L-TWOO RX 2x12 drivetrain and hydraulic discs, Branta 34/50T spider power-meter crank, 12-speed cassette, carbon seatpost and Branta wheel system. It explicitly distinguishes the 2026 2x12 generation from the prior 1x12 model.
